title: silene nocturna subsp. brachypetala
intro: Silene nocturna subsp. brachypetala, commonly known as Night-flowering Catchfly, is a plant species that belongs to the carnation family and is native to the Mediterranean region. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to alleviate various health issues, with its health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Silene nocturna subsp. brachypetala include reducing inflammation, soothing digestive issues, and exhibiting immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
